scientific_question: In independently sampled 2017–2018 Azorean forests, do native taxa with a prior documented island-level local extirpation somewhere in the archipelago comprise a greater share of the native flora's plot occurrences in natural forest than in exotic or production forest, beyond the trivial result that native forests contain more native taxa?
legacy_gate_status: v1.286 exact 10-per-type gate TERMINAL and cannot be reauthorized or scored; v1.287 Event-only diagnostic is not an ecology result
primary_statistic: For each island×forest cell f=total native plot×taxon positives belonging to the PRE-FROZEN 20 S1 Azores historically loss-affected taxa; r=all other strictly native plot×taxon positives. l_i,h=log[(f+0.5)/(r+0.5)]. d_i=l_i,NF−0.5(l_i,EW+l_i,PF). D=(d_Pico+d_SaoMiguel+d_Terceira)/3, all island groups retained. Positive D indicates relative compositional enrichment of the history-of-loss subset in natural forest over alternative stand types, not plant survival, extirpation risk or intervention effects.
focal_taxonomy: S1 Well-supported Extirpation (Island level) rows for Azores, exact 20 canonical binomials, original S1 fixed SHA; no fuzzy synonyms or dropping taxa after ForestEco2 outcome

classification.unknown_policy: unknown or mixed establishment classes, non-species taxonRank, non-canonical binomial: exclude from primary and count as exclusions, no posthoc reclassification
classification.unit: 100m2 independent plot (one Event id), one positive for each unique island/site×taxon, ignore duplicate sub-records; no whole-island absence inference

pilot_estimability_before_score.unknown_class_non_species_exclusion_note: Non-species ranks are excluded from target but contribute to reporting; among eligible species-rank records with clean binomial, >20% unknown/mixed establishment status is a terminal scoring STOP.

uncertainty.resample: 2000 independent with-replacement samples of source plots within each original island×forest cell; calculate D on 9 sampled cells with same frozen 0.5 continuity; fixed seed 1729
uncertainty.ci: Percentile 2.5 and 97.5 via simple sorted interpolation, report descriptive plot-sampling bootstrap and not independent archipelago replication
uncertainty.supported_description: Call positive within-source exploratory compositional contrast only when D>0 and 95% lower bound>0, not causal or pristine confirmatory

secondary: Report nine cells' f and r counts, strictly native and introduced unique plot×taxon incidence, 3 island-specific d_i, taxon-match count and excluded statuses. Do not export names, site IDs, occurrence IDs or coordinates. No alternative threshold subgroup if primary fails.
exclusions: Do not infer habitat assignment from species composition
Do not read prior MOVECLIM biological responses again
Do not mine supplementary S2/S3/S4 or other protected endpoints
No observed immigration, rescue, source-sink or extinction rate
No second scoring pass on negative effect
prior_work_boundary: ForestEco2 authors already establish native-forest indigenous richness hotspots and exotic woodland invasive taxa; those are prior-art baseline, not a new Structural discovery. The cross-source S1 historic-loss-taxonomy composition contrast is the narrowly new question.
